deliverables.details: Added mandatory MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 guidance for rsync and documented global.js CSRF/401 coverage, including raw XMLHttpRequest.
Synchronized 39 canonical skills across .claude, .gemini and .codex in the matrix and four satellites; project-local extra skills were preserved.
c2f-architect-master, c2f-executor-agent and c2f-reviewer-agent are present in all 15 toolkit directories.
585 official skill copies compared across 15 toolkit directories; zero missing files, extra files inside canonical skill folders or hash mismatches.
20/20 Vitest cases passed in global-csrf.test.js and global-auth-redirect.test.js.
Official archive command restored the 10/10 active windows and the final dry-run reported zero orphaned relative links.

An equivalent structural validation checked all 39 canonical skills and reported zero errors.
